name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE
unit: NGN, printed in millions (N millions) and stored absolute (x1000000 = whole Naira)
scale_note: The prospectus states the Naira statements in 'million; multiplied by 1000000 here, the whole-currency unit the other statement files in this tree use. The same statements are also printed in US$ '000 in the prospectus (pages 75 to 76); the Naira columns are used to match the NGX convention.
listing_status: Not listed. SEC-approved offer for subscription open 14 September to 13 October 2026; listing on the NGX Main Board indicated for late November to early December 2026 and NOT fixed. There is no traded price and no market capitalisation: N525.00 is a SUBSCRIPTION price. The prospectus's own indicative market capitalisation at listing (N65,220,180,848,025, page 35 item 17) is an offer-implied figure, not a traded value, and is not carried in these statement files.
source: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE, Initial Public Offering Prospectus dated 07 September 2026 (SEC Nigeria cleared), Historical Financial Information, Statement of Financial Position page 75 and Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income page 76, both printed in Naira 'million and US$ '000; period tables cross-checked at Operating and Financial Review pages 86 to 91; indebtedness at pages 38 and 159. Audited by Deloitte & Touche; reporting accountant KPMG Professional Services. H1 2026 is the six months ended 30 June 2026; FY2025 to FY2021 are the years ended 31 December. Values stored as absolute Naira (printed 'million x 1000000). This is the Nigerian refinery alone: not Dangote Cement Plc, nor the announced, unbuilt Lamu project.

rows.label: Total Equity
rows.note: N14,677,634m = about N14.68tn at 30 June 2026. Thin against total assets because of the debt.

borrowingsNote: Borrowings are the point of this balance sheet. As at 31 December 2025 total borrowings were US$6,242,530,000: secured bank loans of US$2,255,037,000 plus unsecured borrowings of US$3,987,493,000 from Dangote Industries Limited, the controlling shareholder and a related party. As at 30 June 2026 total indebtedness stood at approximately US$5.67bn, all secured (prospectus pages 38 item 35 and 159 paragraph 5). In Naira balance-sheet terms that is non-current N5,653,742m plus current N2,168,529m = N7,822,271m at 30 June 2026 (US$5,665,890 thousand), against non-current N853,978m plus current N8,181,584m = N9,035,562m at 31 December 2025. No separate lease liability is printed in the summary balance sheet. After the balance sheet date the issuer issued US$750m of 7.5% senior unsecured notes due 2031 (page 79), which is not reflected in any column here.
identityChecks: Non-current Assets + Current Assets = Total Assets
Non-current Liabilities + Current Liabilities = Total Liabilities
Total Liabilities + Total Equity = Total Assets
roundingNote: The FY2023 column does not tie to the last digit: Total Liabilities 10,061,167 plus Total Equity 1,983,405 = 12,044,572m, against a printed Total Assets (and Total Equity and Liabilities) of 12,044,573m. That is a one-unit rounding difference in the prospectus itself; the printed figures are stored unchanged and not adjusted.
reconciliation_note: Total Assets, Total Liabilities and Total Equity are the prospectus's printed totals and reconcile on every date except the one-unit FY2023 rounding above. H1 2026 is a balance sheet date (30 June 2026); the others are 31 December. Source: prospectus dated 07 September 2026, page 75, with the indebtedness note at pages 38 and 159.
